info.name: CityCare API
info.description:
CityCare — city complaint and service platform.

1. Import the environment file next to this collection.
2. Run **Auth → Log in** with a seeded account; the token is saved automatically.
3. Citizen1 has 2FA off. ADMIN and OFFICER always get an OTP challenge — run **Log in**, read the code from your inbox, then **Complete the two-factor challenge**.

Every response uses the same envelope: `{ success, message, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, message, errors[], requestId }`.

request.description:
Stores the pending signup in Redis for 10 minutes and emails a 6-digit OTP.
The schema is strict: an unknown key such as `role` is a 400.

request.description:
Returns a tracking id like `CC-2026-000021` and an SLA due date derived from the
category. A second identical report from the same citizen within 24 hours is a 409.
When coordinates are supplied, an open complaint of the same category within 100 m is
reported in `data.possibleDuplicate` — a hint, not a block.

request.description:
The transition map decides which role may make which move. Anything else is
`409 INVALID_TRANSITION`. `RESOLVED` requires at least one `RESOLUTION_PROOF`
attachment. `REJECTED` requires a note. Two concurrent calls give one 200 and one 409.
